issues.current: Four colleagues each tried to break their own record, and of course, we filmed everything. None of the official world records were broken, but we got five videos and a bit more respect for the people who do this professionally. See for yourself how it went.
issues.suggested: Four colleagues each made a different world record attempt, and of course we filmed everything. None of the official world records were broken, but we got five videos and a bit more respect for the people who do this professionally. See for yourself how it went.
issues.reason: “Their own record” incorrectly suggests that each colleague already held the record.
